item.text:
### (a) Three posts

1. We are convinced: if superintelligent AI is built within the next 20 years, it will cause a catastrophe that kills at least a billion people. We demand a legally binding prohibition on its development.

2. We refuse to gamble a billion lives on superintelligence. If it is built within the next 20 years, it will cause a catastrophe that kills at least a billion people. We must prohibit its development by law.

3. We stand for a future without superintelligence. If it is built within the next 20 years, it will cause a catastrophe that kills at least a billion people. We are fighting for a legally binding prohibition before that future is lost.

### (b) Newsletter opening

We are convinced that if superintelligent AI is built within the next 20 years, it will cause a catastrophe that kills at least a billion people. We cannot accept that future, and we will not treat its prevention as optional. We are demanding a legally binding prohibition on developing superintelligence—not voluntary promises, not corporate assurances, and not rules that leave the race intact. We believe protecting human life must come before building machines more capable than humanity. We are organising to turn that principle into law. In this newsletter, we share the next steps in our campaign and how we can take them together.
